verdict.rationale: Devin documents its own API for automating workflows, including programmatic session creation, plus CI/CD pipeline integration. It also ships a local CLI that accepts a prompt as an argument. However, nothing explicitly documents a headless or non-interactive CLI mode, exit codes or output formats for scripting, so terminal-script automation is only implied. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive/headless CLI flag, scriptable output format and exit-code behavior, and hands-on corroboration of scripted runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation

citations.quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.
